steps.instructions: Write plan.md: what already exists (automations, selectors or APIs the project has, with file paths), the flow to automate step by step, the selectors or APIs discovered, what evidence proves it works, and a scope block listing every file the task will change.
Build the Playwright automation as scripts in the project's automation folder (project.json.automationDir, default automations/). Commit on the task branch.
Run the automation end to end against the target, record video and screenshots to .jevellan/evidence/, report what ran and what it produced.
